theme.en: Game art costs and team handoffs
theme.zh: 游戏资产制作成本与团队交接

followup.en:
Your art team can use a small pilot to see whether Team Plan helps with work already on the schedule.

For 10 planned characters or props, the team would compare its current process with Tripo: time to the first useful model, generation and retries, artist cleanup, review and game-engine checks. They would also check whether a teammate can find and reuse an approved asset without another handoff.

That gives you a basis for the budget decision: which work takes less effort overall, and which is better handled as it is today. Files refined outside Tripo remain in your team's own production workflow.

Leave your details to discuss the pilot. Tripo and your team would agree on the scope, access, fees and responsibilities before starting.
followup.zh:
您的美术团队可以先拿排期里的一小部分工作，看看 Team Plan 是否有帮助。

围绕 10 个计划制作的角色或道具，由团队比较现有做法与 Tripo 流程：获得首个可用模型的时间、生成与重试、人工清理、审核和引擎检查。也看看另一位成员是否能直接找到并复用已审核资产，少一次交接。

这些结果能帮助您判断预算该怎么投入：哪些工作总体上更省力，哪些仍适合沿用原来的做法。在 Tripo 外继续修改的文件，仍由您的团队在自己的制作流程里管理。

留下联系方式，沟通这次试点。开始前，Tripo 会与您的团队确认范围、使用权限、费用和具体分工。

subject.en: Can AI lower your team's game art costs?
subject.zh: AI 能帮您的团队降低游戏美术成本吗？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Before you add to the modeling or outsourcing budget, could your art team use AI for part of the work?

Tripo Studio Team Plan gives your art team one workspace to generate starting 3D models from text or reference images and share assets. Artists can find and reuse shared models instead of requesting the same files again. Your team can also manage pooled credits and member access in the same workspace.

Your artists still refine the models and decide what meets the game's requirements. You can then judge whether the approach reduces the team's total time and cost.

Leave your details to discuss a pilot using 10 assets from your project.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

在增加建模或外包预算前，是否可以先让您的美术团队用 AI 承担一部分制作工作？

Tripo Studio Team Plan 让您的美术团队在同一个工作区里，从文字或参考图生成初版 3D 模型，并共享资产。成员可以查找和复用共享模型，少一些反复索要文件的交接；团队积分和成员权限也可以在同一个工作区统一管理。

模型仍由您的美术团队继续修改，并按游戏要求验收。您可以据此判断，这种做法是否真正减少了团队的总工时和成本。

留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通用项目里的 10 个资产做一次小规模试点。

subject.en: Where could AI fit in your next game build?
subject.zh: 下一版游戏里，哪些道具可以让团队试试 AI？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Could your art team use generated models for some of the props in the next game build? The decision depends on how much work it takes to make them fit the project.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, your artists can turn text or reference images into starting 3D models, then refine them in the tools they already use. Team members can find and reuse shared assets in one library. Pooled credits and member access are managed in the same workspace.

Your team decides which models match the art direction and work in the game. You can see where generation and reuse help the project before using the plan more widely.

Leave your details to discuss a pilot using 10 game props, or take a look at the treasure-chest example.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

下一版游戏需要的道具里，有没有一部分可以让您的美术团队从生成模型开始做？是否值得采用，要看把它们做到项目要求还需要多少工作。

使用 Tripo Studio Team Plan，您的美术团队可以从文字或参考图生成初版 3D 模型，再放进熟悉的工具继续制作。成员可以在同一个资产库里查找和复用共享资产，团队积分和成员权限也能在同一个工作区管理。

哪些模型符合美术风格、能用于游戏，仍由您的团队决定。您可以先看清生成和复用对实际项目的帮助，再决定是否扩大使用。

留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通用 10 个游戏道具做一次小规模试点；也可以先看看宝箱制作示例。

theme.en: Add 3D generation without building the model in-house
theme.zh: 接入 3D 生成，不必自建底层模型

followup.en:
Your engineers connect Tripo API to your asset tool: submit text or an image, track the task, and retrieve the model if generation succeeds. They then pass it into your team's refinement and review process. Your team owns the user experience, project standards and final approval.

One option is to benchmark 10 real assets against your current workflow. Your team can check file formats and handoff to its usual tools, then track integration work, generation and retry costs, artist cleanup, review and engine checks. The useful comparison is the time and cost of reaching an approved model, not just generating one. Ongoing integration maintenance belongs in that comparison too.

Leave your details to discuss the benchmark. The scope, access, fees and who will carry out the work need to be agreed before it starts.
followup.zh:
您的工程团队把 Tripo API 接入资产工具：提交文字或图片，跟踪任务，在生成成功后取回模型，再交给美术继续修改和审核。用户体验、项目标准和最终验收仍由您的团队掌握。

一种评测方式是，拿 10 个真实资产与现有流程做对比。团队可以检查文件格式与常用工具是否衔接，再记录接入工作量、生成与重试费用、美术清理、审核和引擎检查。重点是得到通过验收的模型用了多久、花了多少成本，而不只是生成速度；接入后的维护投入也应计入。

留下联系方式，沟通评测安排。开始前需确认范围、使用权限、费用，以及各项工作由谁负责。

subject.en: Does your team need to build its own 3D AI?
subject.zh: 给游戏工具加上 3D 生成，一定要自研吗？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Does adding 3D generation to your game tools justify building an AI model in-house? An API gives your team another option.

Tripo API lets your engineers connect text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation to the tools your team already uses. Tripo provides the generation service; your engineers build the integration. Your artists can refine the results in their usual software, with your team setting the quality standards and deciding what goes into the game.

A benchmark using your own project assets can help you assess the integration work and the cost of getting models approved. Leave your details to discuss an API benchmark with Tripo.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

为了给游戏工具加上 3D 生成，值得投入团队自研底层模型吗？接入 API 是另一种选择。

Tripo API 可以让您的工程团队把文生 3D、图生 3D 接入现有工具。Tripo 提供生成服务，您的工程团队负责接入。美术可以在熟悉的软件里继续修改生成结果，由您的团队制定质量标准，决定哪些模型能用于游戏。

用自己项目里的资产做一次对比评测，能帮助您判断接入要投入多少工作、模型达到验收要求要花多少成本。留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通 API 评测安排。

Leave your details to discuss a benchmark for your platform. Scope, access, fees and responsibilities need to be agreed before it starts.

您的工程团队把内容平台接入 Tripo API，提交产品图片、跟踪任务，在生成成功后取回模型。内容团队再对照真实产品检查和修改，完成后才发布。Tripo 提供生成能力，查看器由您的团队开发或接入；客户体验和最终审核仍由团队负责。

评测可以先覆盖 10 个真实产品资产。团队检查文件格式、产品还原情况及页面查看器中的表现，再比较生成与重试费用、人工修正、审核，以及首个模型通过验收所需的时间。接入和查看器维护也计入成本。

留下联系方式，沟通适合您平台的评测方案。开始前需确认范围、使用权限、费用和双方分工。

subject.en: Could your team make product models from photos?
subject.zh: 能用产品图片，帮团队做出 3D 展示吗？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Could your team use product photos to start making 3D content for your pages, instead of commissioning every model from scratch?

With Tripo API, your content platform can generate starting 3D models from product images, without your engineers developing the generation model. Your content team checks and refines the results against the actual products, then uses its own viewer to show them on your pages.

Your team keeps control of the customer experience and what gets published. A small benchmark can help you assess the work and cost before extending 3D to more products. Leave your details to discuss an API benchmark with Tripo.
